cohort: The study participants included all children born in Finland between January 1, 1986, and December 31, 2008, diagnosed with T1DM before age 16, and a 10% random sample from each birth year cohort as a reference group.
finding: Children with cow's milk allergy showed an increased risk of developing type 1 diabetes, although this association was not observed when including the use of special infant formulas in the CMA definition.
